desc:
💥 Build, battle, and conquer in the War Game!

A modern classic Tycoon game on war. Experience on Roblox. Build a base, command an army, and prepare for war! Start as a small nation and grow into a powerful world force.

Launch attacks, weaken enemy nations, and defend your homeland from incoming raids. Build your economy, strengthen your military, or strike first and crush your enemies!

🌍 Expand your country and grow your power
💰 Upgrade your economy and boost income
🚀 Unlock powerful weapons and attacks
🛡️ Defend your nation from enemy invasions
⚔️ Battle other countries in intense PvP combat
⚖️ Choose strategy, aggression, or both

Rise from a small country… and become the strongest nation on the battlefield.

Inspired by: [UPD!] Missile Wars and [💥 Launchers] Missile Tycoon

🔥 Play now and lead your country to victory!
